title: Cointegrated same-sector pairs in stock futures
hypothesis: Same-sector F&O stock pairs that are cointegrated over the formation window, traded on z-score divergence in futures, earn a positive return after charges.

mechanism.text: Temporary relative mispricing between close substitutes reverts.

evidence.source: Gatev, Goetzmann and Rouwenhorst, Review of Financial Studies 19(3)
evidence.finding: Simple pairs rules earned excess returns.

evidence.source: Do and Faff, Financial Analysts Journal 66(4)
Indian theses and project write-ups (krishikosh, QuantInsti EPAT)
evidence.finding: Claims of 30%+ a year in stock futures; not peer reviewed.

universe.name: fno-stocks-pit-sectors
universe.rule: Stocks in the F&O list on the formation date, paired within NSE sector classification.

holding_period: days to weeks, at most 20 sessions

turnover.basis: 2 legs x about 20 round trips a year x 0.123% stock futures round trip

prior_trials.basis: No pairs rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout net after charges above zero over at least 30 pair trades.

kill_criteria: Holdout net at or below zero after charges.
More than a third of holdout pair trades ending at the stop.

prior.reason: Faded globally; Indian claims unreviewed; pairs break on company news.

feasibility.reason: Needs a pairs engine (#72) and stock futures history (#71).

contamination: Discovery's 527 daily rule trials and the equity library ran on about 2.3 years of daily bars (2024 to 2026) of NIFTY 50 stocks: single-stock timing rules, not this cross-sectional rule. No cross-sectional portfolio has been run on any part of this span in this repo.
